intro: Serge Hinott is a Forsaken alchemist stationed in Tarren Mill in the Hillsbrad Foothills. Working closely alongside Apothecary Lydon, he assists the Royal Apothecary Society with brewing concoctions, antidotes, and reagents essential to the Forsaken war effort.

p: Positioned beside Apothecary Lydon in the fortified settlement of Tarren Mill, Serge Hinott plays a crucial supporting role for Forsaken operations in Hillsbrad Foothills. While Lydon focuses on broader chemical development and aggressive plague research against neighboring human settlements like Southshore, Hinott manages specialized brewing tasks. His expertise includes preparing restorative salves and critical antidotes required when field agents and scouts encounter dangerous poisons and toxic mishaps.
